newsitem.title: HUNGARY: KEKKUTI DEBUTS OVER SUBSCRIPTION PRICE IN BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: KEKKUTI DEBUTS OVER SUBSCRIPTION PRICE IN BUDAPEST.

text.p: Trading in the shares of Hungarian mineral water company Kekkuti Asvanyviz Rt started slowly on Monday, with a wide spread in prices, traders said.
The Budapest Stock Exchange listed 2,359,260 Kekkuti shares today.
The first few deals were concluded at 1,315 forints each. Turnover in the paper had reached 500 shares by 1150 GMT.
"Bids are at 1,260 forints while asks are at 1,350 forints," one trader said over the phone.
Later bids were between 1,310 and 1,320 forints while asks were at 1,355 and 1,400 forints, he said.
The 100-forint-face value shares were publicly offered at 1,280 forints.
One trader said all the deals were concluded for those shares coming from the public offer and entitling shareholders for dividends for the last quarter of the year.
